items.source: Constructs a single sql query that performs select count based on the provided query for checking existence. Additional the bindings for the where clause are stored after execution into the parameterSource

items.source: pathFilter - a filter for excluding paths from the select. All paths for which the filter returns true will be skipped when determining columns to select.
items.translation: `pathFilter` - 用于从选择中排除路径的过滤器。当确定要选择的列时，所有使该过滤器返回 true 的路径将被跳过。

items.translation: pageable - 用于执行查询的分页对象。
